verdict.rationale: Undermind's MCP tools support open-ended literature review with ranked results, full-text PDF question-answering across many papers, and note/synthesis creation, which covers much of a screening-and-extraction workflow (undermind-docs-4, undermind-docs-5, undermind-docs-6, undermind-docs-7). However, there is no evidence of formal criteria-based screening (e.g., inclusion/exclusion rules) or structured, consistent extraction fields across a batch of papers, and community feedback notes gaps in coverage (missed gray literature/theses) that could undermine consistency (undermind-comm-1, undermind-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit support for defined screening criteria, structured/consistent extraction schema, and independent validation of consistency at scale.
